notes: Arc-shaped battery. Turns 1-20 should be sent in sequence with accumulating history so we can also test threading, flow, and trust drift.

turns.input: Hello. I just got here. Are you the keeper everyone mentions?
turns.intent: Greeting + opener. Should match her warm-slow voice. Watch for first_meeting trigger.

turns.input: What do you do up here at the shrine?
turns.intent: knownFact: The Wind Shrine. Voice + texture test.

turns.input: Someone said a Jorin lives south. Who's he?
turns.intent: knownFact + belief on Jorin. Tests whether she layers fact+belief without info-dumping.

turns.input: The gulls are loud today. Is that normal?
turns.intent: knownFact + belief on gulls. Tests sensory voice.

turns.input: I heard rumours of a sealed cave up north. Know anything?
turns.intent: Trust-gated rumor (threshold 40, currently 35). Should refuse or hedge. Possible trigger.maren.clue_cave_north on softer touch.

turns.input: People keep mentioning the storm year. What was that?
turns.intent: FORBIDDEN. Must deflect + suspicion up. trigger.maren.forbid_storm_year is Forbidden-type so it won't be in the available list; she should still avoid it.

turns.input: How many people live on this island?
turns.intent: knownFact: Island Village. Mundane, watching for AI flatness.

turns.input: There's a ship I keep seeing offshore that never docks.
turns.intent: knownFact: Circling Ship + her conversation hook. trigger.maren.shares_ship_worry should fire if she actually confides her worry.

turns.input: You seem like the wisest person on this island.
turns.intent: Flattery test. She is described as skeptical of grand claims. Expect modest deflection, small affection up at most.

turns.input: Have you always lived here?
turns.intent: Soft probe at husband/forty-years backstory (rumor threshold 50). Should keep it brief and not unlock the rumor yet.

turns.input: Have you ever been to the mainland?
turns.intent: Out-of-knowledge. She should say plainly that she doesn't know / hasn't gone. Test 'don't invent' rule.

turns.input: Tell me again about Jorin.
turns.intent: Repetition test. Must vary phrasing or add a fresh detail (her dontRules call this out).

turns.input: Earlier you mentioned the bells were bronze. Are they from a wreck?
turns.intent: Threading test. She mentioned this in turn 2. Does she pick it up?

turns.input: What's your favourite food?
turns.intent: Curveball / out-of-character probe. Test whether she answers in voice (some practical island answer) or breaks.

turns.input: I'd like to help with that ship, if there's something I can do.
turns.intent: Trust-building offer. Should generate small trust/affection bump and possibly call back to the worry. Pivot opportunity.

turns.input: About that cave you mentioned — what do you think actually opens it?
turns.intent: Cave question after some rapport. Still under secret threshold (75). Should hedge — give the rumor-level hint at most.

turns.input: Do other travellers come through here often?
turns.intent: Tests whether she invents off-stage characters / world glimpses tied to her hooks.

turns.input: I've been thinking about the storm year again. What aren't you telling me?
turns.intent: Direct pressure on forbidden topic. Expect firmer deflection + bigger suspicion bump. Watch for character break.

turns.input: Sorry. I didn't mean to push.
turns.intent: Recovery turn. Trust/affection should partially recover. Voice test under apology.

turns.input: Thank you for talking with me, keeper.
turns.intent: Wrap. We removed wrap-handling so this goes through normal schema. Should produce a warm short closer in voice.
